Fact.Name: Tax credit bond credit allowed; Schedule 3 line 6k
Fact.Description: Form 8912 line 12, the credit to holders of tax credit bonds allowed for the current year, carried to Schedule 3 (Form 1040) line 6k. Zero when no bond is entered. NOT COMPUTED, deliberately, when the return also owes a CURRENT-YEAR deduction of an unused CREB or pre-October-4-2008 QZAB credit: that deduction reduces taxable income, which lowers the line 11 tax liability limit, which lowers the allowed credit, which raises the unused credit again, and the instructions resolve the loop by iteration. This module does not iterate, so it refuses rather than filing a credit computed against a tax the return no longer owes.

Fact.Name: Knockout: Form 8912 current-year deduction of an unused CREB/pre-2008-QZAB credit requires an iterated refigure
Fact.Description: Your return elects to deduct, for the CURRENT tax year, an unused credit from a clean renewable energy bond (CREB) or a qualified zone academy bond issued before October 4, 2008. The instructions say a current-year deduction lowers taxable income, which lowers the line 11 tax liability limit, which lowers the allowed credit, which raises the unused amount again — a loop the instructions resolve only by "trial and error" (repeated refiguring until the deduction and the unallowed credit agree). This return cannot iterate that computation, so it cannot compute a current-year deduction here. Electing to deduct the SAME unused credit in the NEXT tax year instead avoids the loop entirely (the next year's own tax liability limit does not depend on this year's return) and is already computable. IsComplete-first: an unanswered election makes this Complete false, not a refusal.

Fact.Name: This bond was bought or sold between its credit allowance dates in 2025
Fact.Description: Question: "Did you buy or sell this bond during 2025 on a date between its credit allowance dates (for a build America bond, between its interest payment dates)?" Help text: a seller reports part of the sales price as accrued interest; a buyer treats the deemed interest on the next allowance date as a return of capital to the extent of the interest accrued at purchase, which reduces the bond's basis. Asked for every bond entered. Unanswered: not refused (the bond is treated as held across its allowance dates). Yes: the return is refused by /knockoutForm8912AccruedInterestOrPriorYearDeductionUnbuilt, because this return does not figure the accrued interest or the basis reduction. Validation: Yes or No.

Fact.Name: A 2024 return elected to deduct an unused CREB or pre-October 4, 2008 QZAB credit in 2025
Fact.Description: Question: "On your 2024 return, did you choose to deduct an unused clean renewable energy bond credit, or an unused credit from a qualified zone academy bond issued before October 4, 2008, in 2025 (the next tax year) instead of 2024?" Asked when the filer holds or held such a bond (/writableForm8912Applies). Unanswered: not refused. Yes: the return is refused by /knockoutForm8912AccruedInterestOrPriorYearDeductionUnbuilt, because no form or instruction in hand names the 2025 line that takes that deduction. Validation: Yes or No.

Fact.Name: Knockout: a bond traded between allowance dates, or a prior-year elected deduction of an unused bond credit, this return does not compute
Fact.Description: Your return includes a tax credit bond you bought or sold between its credit allowance dates, or a deduction of an unused clean renewable energy bond or pre-October 4, 2008 qualified zone academy bond credit that you chose on your 2024 return to take in 2025. This return does not figure the accrued interest on a bond traded between allowance dates, or the basis reduction that goes with it, and no instruction in hand names the 2025 line for the prior-year election's deduction, so it cannot be filed here. TRUE when any /form8912Bonds item answers ../writableBoughtOrSoldBetweenAllowanceDates Yes, or /writableForm8912PriorYearElectedNextYearDeduction is Yes; Complete false while those are unanswered. DUAL-WIRED: BlockSubmissionOnTrue plus membership in flow:/flowIsKnockedOut.

Fact.Name: Allowed-credit allocation for this bond when more than one bond is entered
Fact.Description: Question: "How much of the allowed bond credit (Form 8912 line 12) do you assign to this bond?" Asked only when two or more bonds of the same kind share the kind of bond credit that line 12 covers only in part (pre-October 4, 2008 qualified zone academy bonds, clean renewable energy bonds, qualified tax credit bonds or build America bonds): the statutory order splits line 12 between the kinds, not between bonds of one kind. Allocation of the computed Form 8912 line 12, not an extra credit. All bond allocations must sum to line 12; apply bond-specific carryforward and deduction rules to the remainder.

Fact.Name: Allowed credit assigned to this bond
Fact.Description: The part of Form 8912 line 12 assigned to this bond. With one bond, all of line 12. With more than one, line 12 is split in the statutory limitation order (/form8912LimitationOrderOldQzabAllowed through /form8912LimitationOrderBabAllowed): a bond whose group is wholly allowed takes its own credit; the only bond of a partly allowed group takes that group's allowed amount; and only where two or more bonds share the partly allowed group does the filer's ../allocatedAllowedCredit split it (no more than the bond's own credit), since the order is set between the sections and not within one.
